notes: Limpid for Windows 10 and 11, the same app as on the Mac: your albums with their covers and each album's details, the colours of the music with the drop, the waveform, Playing on for Limpid OS computers, and your account.
Limpid plays with your Limpid license: sign in when it opens, then Activate on This PC (your account, at the foot of the sidebar).
Exclusive mode (Settings > Sound) is on: Limpid uses your device on its own, at each file's own sample rate, with nothing of Windows in the way.

Installing: Limpid is installed for you, with no administrator rights. Windows may say it doesn't know the app yet: choose More info, then Run anyway. Settings > Apps removes it; your music and your settings stay.
Check for Updates (Settings) looks for a new version only when you ask.
Experimental (Settings): Straight to the driver gives the music to your device's own driver.
